title: 云计算与SaaS产业结构分析
core_insight: AWS、Google Cloud和Salesforce等领军企业在云计算和SaaS领域持续创新，技术和基础设施更新频繁，资本信号显示出强烈的融资和战略投资动向，风险信号主要体现在监管和安全方面

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出MicroVMs，支持Kubernetes版本回滚，Google Cloud的C4A-metal和Panasonic Automotive vSkipGen的合作 AWS Certificate Manager支持ACME协议，Amazon EC2 C9g和C9gd实例上线，Google Cloud的BigQuery和IAM数据管理的更新 AWS Weekly Roundup: One-click Lambda setup prompt, OpenAI GPT-5.6 models on Bedrock, and more Accelerating automotive innovation with C4A-metal and Panasonic Automotive vSkipGen Level Up Your Column-level Security: Using IAM Data Governance Tags in BigQuery Azure Databricks delivers proven business value Frontier models and production agents: Advancing Microsoft Foundry for the agentic era Cloudflare Internal DNS is now generally available Your Worker can now have its own cache in front of it
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出CloudFormation Express模式，提高部署速度 Amazon EC2 C9g和C9gd实例上线，采用AWS Graviton5处理器，火山引擎的云产品发布 Accelerate your infrastructure deployments by up to 4x with AWS CloudFormation Express mode Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now available 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵
